name: @digitaplatform/veloluck-lakeside
description: Veloluck Lakeside: a FREE signature of Veloluck GmbH, the fictional bike workshop and shop that opens digita show; the ride out of the door: lake and forest green #1F7A5C, cool neutrals, a diagonal contour motif and a soft glow, Manrope in every role. One of three looks the company chooses from in the signature menu. Made from signature.json by make-signature, which refuses a text or control pair below WCAG AA except step 600 drawn as text, which no brand colour passes in both modes until digita-platform#240; ships as pure config (no runtime CSS).
